hero.lede: Fire-grilled kabobs, shawarma sliced to order, and family dinners that feed six. Order ahead and pick up at Louetta. Then take home the same halal meat and spices from our market.

title.locations: Locations & Hours · Zamani Grill & Market, Spring TX
locs.h1: Two places in Spring, one family.
locs.lede: The restaurant and the original market are together on Louetta Rd. The second market, grocery only, is on Riley Fuzzel Rd near the Grand Parkway.

market.h1: The halal market. Order ahead, pick up at either store.

title.louetta: Zamani Grill & Market, Louetta Rd · Lebanese Restaurant & Halal Market in Spring, TX 77379
louetta.h1: Zamani Grill & Market on Louetta Rd, Spring, Texas
louetta.lede: The original. A Lebanese grill with the halal market beside it, in the shopping center across from the mosque near Champion Forest Dr. Eat in, order pickup, or shop for the week.
louetta.parking: Free parking in front. Catering pickup at the counter; call ahead for large orders.
louetta.h.1s: Full menu: shawarma, kabobs, family dinners, sandwiches, salads
louetta.h.2s: Beef, lamb, goat and chicken cut to order
louetta.h.3s: Seven spice, sumac, za'atar, basmati, tahini, olive oil, pita
louetta.h.4s: Family dinners, skewers by the dozen, trays
louetta.band.h2: Order here, not through the app, and the kitchen keeps the difference.
louetta.band.p: Delivery apps take a large cut of every order. Pickup orders placed on this site go straight to the grill at the menu price.
title.rf: Zamani International Market, Riley Fuzzel Rd · Halal Grocery in Spring, TX 77386
rf.h1: Zamani International Market on Riley Fuzzel Rd, Spring, Texas
rf.lede: Our second market, close to the Grand Parkway and Rayford Rd. Halal meat cut to order, the spices we cook with, and the pantry staples of a Lebanese kitchen. No restaurant at this location; for hot food, visit Louetta.
rf.h.3s: Not at this store. The grill is at Louetta Rd, about 15 minutes west.
rf.band.h2: Order your meat ahead and skip the wait at the counter.
rf.band.p: Choose Riley Fuzzel as your pickup store at checkout. We cut it fresh and have it wrapped when you arrive.
